description: MilkyWays is a farmer-centered decision-support tool built for Field Shift: Adapting Farms with NASA Data. Using live NASA POWER 25-year agroclimatology alongside local soil type, acreage, and farmer-chosen priorities (soil health, water efficiency, heat resilience, feed quality, and waste-heat proximity), compares 4 candidate fodder crop rotations—including the farm's existing baseline—showing why each is suggested, its bare-field vulnerability window, synthetic nitrogen savings and key gaps.
